verdict.rationale: An in-product AI assistant is a fair axis for a design tool, but the evidence documents no built-in assistant. Penpot only offers an MCP server so users can bring their own external agent, and AI features exist only as community plugins. Both are adjacent capabilities, not a native assistant that users delegate tasks to inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Choose your agent, connect to Penpot MCP and prompt away!
Community plugin marketplace with accessibility, code, AI, and design system tools.
